As a language acquisition expert, our teachers will ensure a language focus and provide opportunities for quality interactions in the classroom. As a supporter, they provide students meaningful access to grade-level curriculum, ensuring that high support and high rigor are embedded into classroom instruction.

And as an advocate, they ensure appropriate class program and placement and share their expertise.
